intro: Cricket and athletics are popular in Saint Lucia, which won its first Olympic gold in 2024.

chapters.title: Julien Alfred
text: Julien Alfred won the women's 100 m at the 2024 Olympics, Saint Lucia's first ever Olympic medal.

chapters.title: Cricket
text: Daren Sammy captained the West Indies to two T20 World Cup wins; the national stadium is named after him.
